note: Image Optimize - Binaries provides nine ImageAPIOptimizeProcessor plugin instances (advdef, advpng, jfifremove, jpegoptim, jpegtran, optipng, pngcrush, pngout, pngquant) that shell out to local binaries; the ImageAPIOptimizeProcessor plugin TYPE and the pipeline config entity are defined by the parent imageapi_optimize module, so provides_plugin_types=[]. It has no configure route (configure=null). All state is grounded in imageapi_optimize_pipeline config entities (config name imageapi_optimize.pipeline.<name>) whose processors[] carry {id, weight, uuid, data}, plus the shared imageapi_optimize.settings:default_pipeline (ships null) and the shipped optional pipeline imageapi_optimize.pipeline.local_binaries. Medium cases read back a known processor setting from a namespaced pipeline; hard cases build a namespaced pipeline (and set the default) verified against live config. Binaries need not be installed for config to be created/verified.

evals.prompt: The Drupal module imageapi_optimize_binaries adds Image Optimize processor plugins that call local command-line binaries. Name at least three of the processor plugin ids it ships for optimizing PNG images.
evals.expected_output: For PNGs it ships optipng, pngquant, pngcrush, pngout, advpng and advdef (advdef/advpng recompress the deflate stream). For JPEGs it ships jpegoptim, jpegtran and jfifremove.

evals.prompt: In imageapi_optimize_binaries, if a processor's binary (say jpegoptim) is not auto-detected on the server's PATH, how can an administrator tell it where the executable is, and which permission controls that?
evals.expected_output: Each binary processor has a manual_executable_path setting (the 'Manually set path' textfield on the processor form). That field is only shown to users with the 'configure imageapi_optimize_binary paths' permission; getFullPathToBinary() returns manual_executable_path if set, otherwise the auto-detected path.

evals.prompt: imageapi_optimize_binaries ships a ready-made Image Optimize pipeline containing all of its processors. What is that pipeline's machine name, and which configuration setting makes a pipeline the site-wide default used by image styles?
evals.expected_output: The shipped optional pipeline is local_binaries (config imageapi_optimize.pipeline.local_binaries, label 'Local Binaries'). The site default is set in imageapi_optimize.settings:default_pipeline (ships as null); set it with e.g. `drush cset imageapi_optimize.settings default_pipeline local_binaries`.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has an Image Optimize pipeline with machine name imageapi_bin_evalq. Inspect the live configuration and state the JPEG quality value that its jpegoptim processor is configured with.
evals.expected_output: 77: in imageapi_optimize.pipeline.imageapi_bin_evalq the jpegoptim processor's data.quality is 77 (readable via `drush cget imageapi_optimize.pipeline.imageapi_bin_evalq processors`).

evals.prompt: The Image Optimize pipeline imageapi_bin_evalp on this site has a pngquant processor whose executable path has been set manually. Inspect the live configuration and give the exact binary path it is configured to use.
evals.expected_output: /opt/custom/bin/pngquant: in imageapi_optimize.pipeline.imageapi_bin_evalp the pngquant processor's data.manual_executable_path is /opt/custom/bin/pngquant.

evals.prompt: Using the imageapi_optimize_binaries module, create an Image Optimize pipeline with machine name imageapi_bin_eval that contains a single jpegoptim processor configured with a JPEG quality of 82. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create the imageapi_optimize_pipeline config entity named imageapi_bin_eval and add a processor id=jpegoptim with data.quality=82 (e.g. $p=storage->create(['name'=>'imageapi_bin_eval','label'=>'...']); $p->addProcessor(['id'=>'jpegoptim','weight'=>1,'data'=>['manual_executable_path'=>'','quality'=>82,'progressive'=>'','size'=>'']]); $p->save();). Verified against imageapi_optimize.pipeline.imageapi_bin_eval.

evals.prompt: Create an Image Optimize pipeline named imageapi_bin_evald that contains an optipng processor, and make it the site's default image optimization pipeline (imageapi_optimize.settings default_pipeline). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create pipeline imageapi_bin_evald with an optipng processor, then set imageapi_optimize.settings default_pipeline to imageapi_bin_evald (drush cset imageapi_optimize.settings default_pipeline imageapi_bin_evald). Verified: default_pipeline==imageapi_bin_evald and the pipeline contains an optipng processor.
